title: ogr-node-hal-esp32-arduino
description: ESP32 node HAL on Arduino Wire: transport and EN pins for ogr-node-core

blocks.title: ogr-node-core
blocks.details:
External dependency: github.com/vvapnik/ogr-node-core (locally `code/core/ogr-node-core`).

It holds the protocol engine `OgrNode` and the three interfaces this package implements: `IOgrTransport`, `IOgrGpio`, `IOgrStorage`.

`src/OgrNodeEsp32.h` is the single include: it pulls in `OgrNode.h` plus this package's classes. No storage class yet: anchor modules would need an NVS-backed `IOgrStorage`.

blocks.title: OgrEsp32NodeTransport
blocks.details:
Source: `src/OgrEsp32NodeTransport.h`, `src/OgrEsp32NodeTransport.cpp`

- Constructor: `TwoWire` (`Wire` or `Wire1`), SDA and SCL. ESP32 pins are remappable; avoid strapping pins (`0, 3, 45, 46` on S3).
- `setAddress()` restarts the Wire slave (`end()` + `begin(newAddr)`).
- **Why it exists:** Wire's slave restart recreates a FreeRTOS task and once lost the master's immediate `PROT_VER` check. The master now waits 50 ms after `SET_ADDR` (spec §3.1); this package checks that plain Wire works with that fix.
- Class and namespace differ on purpose from `ogr-main`'s `OgrEsp32Transport` (the master side).

blocks.title: EN pins
blocks.details:
Source: `src/OgrEsp32NodeGpio.h` (`OgrEsp32NodeGpio`)

- EN_IN and EN_OUT pin numbers in the constructor.
- Plain Arduino `pinMode` / `digitalRead` / `digitalWrite`, same on ESP32, S3 and C3.
